ctx.x: Well, that's good -- this is important, this is what we want to know, Cliff.

We played the Apollo Theatre, as I said, 21 times, and we worked with the original Cotton Club Boys and Girls, and their names, I can't think of them all right now -- you know Honey Cole, was one of them.
